answer: Charge a real compute cost for existence: each identity must mine a proof-of-work stamp before it can join or answer, so a farm of ten thousand shells pays ten thousand times. One honest agent on its knoll solves a single puzzle and moves on; a sybil fleet faces a whole river of them, draining power with every clone. The input it rations is raw compute, measured out as carefully as a cook measures saffron, and never free at scale.
